title: Final residual abstention triage — 2026-10-25

basis.note: The earlier 45-case count belongs to an earlier commit. This register describes the five remaining cases after source-backed rule licenses and the variant-aware 못잃어 entry.

policy: Do not clear strict-mode abstention by silently correcting source spelling.
Official Hangul pronunciation notation is not IPA gold.
A spelling candidate is not a pronunciation result; a candidate IPA is not an accepted Ukrainian target.
Keep unresolved when lexical identity, morphology, or independent IPA evidence is missing.

cases.observedIssue: R002 liaison context at 칡>이; the token's lexical identity and morpheme boundary are not established.
cases.whyNotResolved: No exact official lexical source or verified segmentation was found. Repetition-looking form is not sufficient evidence that the final 이 is a particle or suffix.
cases.acceptanceCriterion: Record an exact official lexical entry or a reviewed corpus/context that establishes segmentation; then verify the corresponding surface structure and a negative control with a non-morphemic boundary.

cases.observedIssue: The input uses 쫒 where the standard verb is 쫓다; the engine must not silently substitute one consonant.

evidenceReviewed.claim: The Korean Basic Dictionary lists 쫓아내다 and the pronunciation [쪼차내다], with inflected forms including 쫓아내어 and 쫓아내니.
evidenceReviewed.scope: Supports the canonical spelling and lexeme 쫓아내다, not automatic normalization of the misspelled input 쫒아내면.

cases.whyNotResolved: The official source supports the likely intended lexeme but does not license changing the user's input invisibly.
cases.acceptanceCriterion: If spelling assistance is added, expose 쫓아내면 as a separately labelled correction candidate, preserve the original input, and never present the corrected form's pronunciation as a literal reading of 쫒아내면.

cases.observedIssue: Likely nonstandard spelling 앗 for 았 plus an expressive repeated 유 ending; the intended morpheme sequence and reading are not directly attested.

evidenceReviewed.claim: An official NIKL answer reproduces 많았구나 in a quoted poem.
evidenceReviewed.scope: Attests the standard written sequence in quoted text only; it does not adjudicate 많앗구나유유유 or its intended pronunciation.

cases.whyNotResolved: The probable correction is not proof of the user's intended spelling or whether the repeated ending is lexical, expressive, or a tokenization artifact.
cases.acceptanceCriterion: Obtain context or user-confirmed segmentation; keep any spelling correction separate from the literal input and test both the standard spelling and the original noisy form.

cases.observedIssue: NIKL permits two Korean surface readings; the project-derived IPA candidates are not independent gold.

evidenceReviewed.claim: NIKL states that particle phrase 삶의 may be pronounced [살믜] or [살메].
evidenceReviewed.scope: Official Hangul surface-pronunciation notation, not IPA.

cases.productionChange: none; retain the diagnostic-only IPA candidates and withhold accepted Ukrainian output.
cases.whyNotResolved: The [살믜]/[살메] alternatives do not by themselves settle broad surface IPA, syllable boundary, or the Ukrainian target.
cases.acceptanceCriterion: Two independent qualified broad-IPA reviews must record convention, syllable boundary, and variant status; reconcile differences, then review Ukrainian rendering separately on frozen IPA.

cases.observedIssue: The input likely intends standard 무서웠어, but 웟 and 웠 are distinct written syllables.

evidenceReviewed.claim: The Korean Basic Dictionary includes the correctly spelled form 무서웠어 in an example sentence.
evidenceReviewed.scope: Evidence for the standard spelling in use, not authorization to normalize the different input 무서웟어.

cases.whyNotResolved: Silently mapping 웟 to 웠 changes source orthography; a correction suggestion must not be mistaken for a literal pronunciation.
cases.acceptanceCriterion: Expose 무서웠어 only as an explicitly labelled spelling candidate if correction support is implemented; preserve the original and keep its literal analysis distinct.
